requirements.requirement: The system must include unit tests that validate Pydantic schema acceptance of valid prescription records with NPI, drug code, volume, and mapped condition.
The system must include unit tests that reject prescription records missing required schema fields.
The system must include unit tests that verify ingestion pipeline correctly normalizes drug identifiers into a canonical format.
The system must include unit tests that confirm aggregation of prescription data by provider NPI produces deterministic results.
The system must include unit tests that verify prescriptions are correctly mapped to ICD-10 conditions using the mapping logic.
The system must include unit tests that validate scoring logic produces a normalized score within an expected bounded range.
The system must include unit tests that verify identical input datasets always yield identical prescribing scores.
The system must include integration tests that execute the full pipeline from ingestion through scoring and confirm end-to-end output structure matches the defined contract.
The system must include integration tests that call the Evaluate Care API endpoint and verify a successful response includes prescribing score and summary fields.
The system must include integration tests that verify API responses conform to the facade contract defined in evaluate_care_facade.
The system must include tests that simulate sparse prescribing data and verify the scoring logic still returns a valid but appropriately adjusted score.
The system must include tests that simulate missing prescribing data and verify the system returns a controlled empty or fallback response without crashing.
The system must include tests that verify LLM-assisted condition mapping produces consistent outputs when given the same ambiguous input.
The system must include tests that verify LLM-assisted mapping outputs conform to the expected ICD-10 schema format.
The system must include tests that validate fallback behavior when LLM mapping fails or returns low-confidence results.
The system must include tests that ensure scoring logic remains stable when LLM-derived mappings are partially missing.
The system must include tests that verify no hallucinated conditions are introduced by LLM mapping beyond provided inputs.
The system must include tests that confirm LLM outputs are deterministic under controlled test conditions (e.g., seeded or mocked responses).
The system must include tests that validate graceful degradation when LLM services are unavailable.
The system must include tests that ensure LLM-derived mappings do not break downstream scoring or API serialization.
